decisions.decision: Wave 1 batches T1/T2/T4/T5 into one serial worker rather than four parallel ones
decisions.why: Tasks are small and disjoint; one dispatch amortizes the doc-pack read, and parallel workers drain the same 5-hour bucket faster for no wall-clock gain here.

decisions.decision: Continued into wave 2 in the same session instead of checkpointing at the wave boundary
decisions.why: Skill recommends /clear+resume on 3+ wave changes, but 5h sits at 12% and context at 13% — a re-read cycle would cost more than carrying this context forward.

decisions.decision: Worker is authorized to run `make templ` and `make css`
decisions.why: Both are codegen phases of `make generate` alongside sqlc, which CLAUDE.md allows outright. Neither runs tests; T3.3 requires them for the CSS-freshness guard.

decisions.decision: Accepted the worker's out-of-spec Consumed: HistoryChart{Empty:true} in the two DashboardHistoryFragment early returns
decisions.why: Both literals already set Odometer and Battery the same way; leaving Consumed at its zero value would render a 0-bar SVG instead of the empty state. Flagged to the reviewer.
